title: Expression/Idle animations for faces: tool recommendations?
author: Capable-Avocado5963
selftext:
I have been experimenting with using nano banana to generate different facial expressions (it’s awesome!) but I would like to animate each of the expressions into 1-5s loops. I tried a bunch of AI video tools (runway, pika, midjourney) but the animations are too much — i want subtle animations that can be used in a game (i am working on designing some characters that you can talk to).

Any recommendations for tools that specialize in this? I saw posts for sprite animations but they seem to focus on walking/running animations instead of different expressions/actions. TIA!

comments.author: fisj
comments.body: I'd crack open comfy UI, and look around for a Wan LoRA for expressions. If one doesn't exist it shouldnt be too hard to train your own with something like ai-toolkit. Its not off the shelf, and it requires getting into development, but its well worth it (imho) as it will give you the flexibility to customize image and video models for whatever purpose you need in the future.

replies.author: Capable-Avocado5963
replies.body: Thanks! I've been fearing diving into comfy UI myself, but maybe it's time to make the leap. Appreciate the help!

replies.author: melonboy55
replies.body: Comfy cloud is a good option too if you don't have the gpus

replies.author: Capable-Avocado5963
replies.body: Thanks! I tried out comfy cloud today, but it was a bit hard to figure out which models were best for my use-case. I ended up using apis to stitch a workflow for nano banana + kling 2.5 with replicate instead. The videos are still not great quality for what i was hoping for though. I am guessing my prompts are not good enough. I’ll keep exploring!

replies.author: melonboy55
replies.body:
Good luck ❤️

Veo 3 or Sora 2 should get you better results than kling
